en.name: Beef broth, stock or consommé (commercial)
en.summary: Commercially produced beef broth, stock and consommé come as cans, cartons, concentrates and cubes, and the cupboard answer is a rule rather than a number: an unopened pack keeps to the use-by date printed on it. Refrigerated, broth runs about 7 days, or 3–4 days once the pack is opened. It freezes for about 2–3 months.
en.pantry: For an unopened can or carton there is no fixed timeline to give — go by the package use-by date, stored cool, dry and out of the sun. Once a pack is opened, the pantry is no longer an option: broth is a low-acid, protein-rich liquid and it spoils quickly at room temperature, so put it away within two hours, or one hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F). Never leave a pot of broth on the stove to cool overnight.
en.fridge: Keep broth at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, in a sealed container rather than the opened can. Prepared or fresh refrigerated broth runs about 7 days; an opened shelf-stable carton or can is about 3–4 days. Cool it quickly before it goes in — a shallow container, or the pot sat in a sink of iced water, gets it out of the 4–60 °C (40–140 °F) danger zone far faster than a deep pot will. Reheat only the portion you need, and bring it to a full boil.
en.freezer: Broth freezes well and is worth portioning: pour it into containers or flat bags at −18 °C (0 °F), leaving headspace, where it holds about 2–3 months of good quality. Frozen food held at that temperature stays safe indefinitely, so the timeline is about flavour. Ice-cube trays are useful for the small amounts a pan sauce needs; a flat frozen bag stacks and thaws fast.
en.thawing: Thaw broth in the fridge, or tip the block straight into a hot pan and melt it. Never thaw it on the counter, and bring thawed broth to a rolling boil before use.
spoilage: A bulging, leaking or badly dented can — discard without opening
Cloudiness, ropy strands or a slimy texture in what should be a clear liquid
A sour, fermented or off smell
Bubbles or fizzing in a container that is not meant to be carbonated
tips: Decant an opened can into a glass or plastic container straight away.
Freeze in the portion sizes you actually cook with, and label them.
Cool broth fast in a shallow dish rather than slowly in a deep pot.
Keep bouillon cubes and concentrate in the cupboard as the long-life standby; the reconstituted broth lasts 3-4 days in the refrigerator.

faq.q: How long does opened beef broth last in the fridge?
faq.a: About 3–4 days once the carton or can is opened, kept at 4 °C or below in a sealed container. Fresh refrigerated broth runs about 7 days.
Yes. Portion it with headspace and freeze at −18 °C for about 2–3 months of good quality.

faq.q: How long does an unopened carton of beef broth keep?
faq.a: There is no fixed timeline — go by the use-by date printed on the package, stored cool and dry.

faq.q: Can you store broth in the opened can?
faq.a: No. Transfer it to a sealed glass or plastic container; once air reaches the can the broth picks up a metallic taste.

zh.name: 市售牛高湯
zh.summary: 市售牛高湯有罐裝、利樂包、濃縮液和高湯塊等形式，而櫥櫃的答案是一條規則而不是一個數字：未開封的包裝以標示的有效日期為準。冷藏方面，高湯大約 7 天，開封後則是 3～4 天。冷凍大約 2～3 個月。
zh.pantry: 未開封的罐頭或紙盒沒有固定天數可以給——請以包裝上的有效日期為準，存放在陰涼乾燥、避免日曬的地方。一旦開封，櫥櫃就不再是選項：高湯是低酸、富含蛋白質的液體，在室溫下很快變質，所以要在兩小時內收進冰箱，廚房超過 32 °C 時縮短為一小時。絕對不要把一鍋高湯留在爐上放涼過夜。
zh.fridge: 請放 4 °C 以下，裝在密封容器裡而不是開過的罐頭中。市售冷藏或現成高湯大約 7 天；常溫包裝開封後大約 3～4 天。放進冰箱前要先快速降溫——用淺容器分裝，或把鍋子坐在裝冰水的水槽裡，都比一整鍋慢慢放涼更快通過 4～60 °C 的危險溫度帶。每次只加熱要用的份量，而且要煮到大滾。
zh.freezer: 高湯很適合冷凍，也值得分裝：留出膨脹空間裝進容器或平放的密封袋，放 −18 °C，風味大約可維持 2～3 個月。食物在這個溫度下安全性可以無限期維持，所以這是風味期限。製冰盒很適合做鍋底醬時需要的小份量；平放冷凍的袋子好堆疊、解凍也快。
zh.thawing: 高湯請放冷藏解凍，或直接把凍塊丟進熱鍋化開。不要放室溫解凍，解凍後使用前要煮到大滾。
spoilage: 罐身鼓起、滲漏或嚴重凹陷——不要開，直接丟掉
本該清澈的湯變濁、出現絲狀物或黏稠感
聞起來發酸、有發酵味或異味
不該有氣泡的容器裡出現氣泡或冒氣
tips: 開罐後立刻移到玻璃或塑膠容器。
按實際下廚會用到的份量分裝冷凍，並貼標籤。
用淺盤快速降溫，不要用深鍋慢慢放涼。
櫥櫃常備高湯塊或濃縮高湯當長效備品；泡開後的高湯在冰箱可以放 3-4 天。

faq.q: 開封的牛高湯放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 紙盒或罐頭開封後，密封放 4 °C 以下大約 3～4 天。市售冷藏高湯則大約 7 天。
可以。留膨脹空間分裝後放 −18 °C，風味大約可維持 2～3 個月。

faq.q: 未開封的牛高湯可以放多久？
faq.a: 沒有固定天數——以包裝上的有效日期為準，存放在陰涼乾燥處。

faq.q: 可以直接把開過的罐頭放冰箱嗎？
faq.a: 不行。請移到密封的玻璃或塑膠容器；空氣接觸罐身後，高湯會帶金屬味。
